parameters.content:
## Scrape manufacturer reviews into Shopify
Finds each product's page on the manufacturer's own store, reads every review of that exact product, checks the set is complete and the same product, asks you in Slack, then gives your review app a CSV with the source on every review. Every star rating is kept and the text is never changed.

### How it works
1. **Setup** creates the `review_sites`, `review_sources`, `reviews` and `review_batches` tables, the **Model number (MPN)** and **Manufacturer review page** product fields, and saves your manufacturer sites.
2. **Find** (hourly) takes products tagged `find-reviews`, uses the review page you pasted or searches the manufacturer's store for the model, and saves the page.
3. **Collect** (hourly) reads the page's reviews (Judge.me widgets and pages that list every review in their structured data), checks them and posts one Slack card per new page.
4. **Review** is your Slack app's Request URL: Approve or Reject a page, and Mark imported once you've uploaded a CSV.
5. **Export** (daily) builds a Judge.me CSV from approved pages and posts it in Slack. You import it in Judge.me.

### Setup
Credentials: Shopify Custom Auth (client ID and secret), Slack API (bot token with `chat:write` and `files:write`), Crypto (Slack signing secret). Fill in each lane's settings, run Setup, publish the workflow and set your Slack app's Request URL to **Slack button click**'s production URL.

### Customisation
`pack_words` decides what counts as a kit or pack. `same_product` is `page` (only reviews of the exact product page) or `title` (also its colours, when the manufacturer pools them). `skip_imported` leaves out reviews the manufacturer imported from somewhere else. No AI model: every check is code.

### Check before you import
Every review in this file will show on your product page. Only approved pages are included, but open the CSV and spot-check a product before you import it, and import each batch once: Judge.me doesn't skip duplicates.

## 1. Setup (run once)
Creates the four tables and the two product fields, then saves the manufacturer sites from its settings. Running it again is safe.

## 2. Find (hourly)
Tagged products. A page you pasted into the product's **Manufacturer review page** field wins; otherwise it searches each manufacturer site for the model (or the exact title) and skips kits and packs.

## 3. Collect (hourly)
Reads each new page (and approved ones again every week): every review, every page of them. Holds anything incomplete or for another product. New pages become Slack cards.

## 4. Review (Slack's Request URL)
Answers Slack at once, checks the signature, age and approvers. Approve or Reject a page; Mark imported closes a CSV batch.

## 5. Export (daily)
New reviews from approved pages, whole products only, as a Judge.me CSV in a Slack thread. Import it, then click Mark imported.

nodes.name: Setup settings
nodes.notes: manufacturer_sites: one row per site. brand is your products' Vendor (case doesn't matter), domain is the manufacturer's own store, source_name is what shoppers see next to each review.

nodes.name: Create review_sites

parameters.query:
create table if not exists review_sites (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  brand text,
  domain text,
  source_name text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table if not exists review_sources (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  product_id text,
  product_title text,
  product_handle text,
  brand text,
  model text,
  url text,
  source_name text,
  found_by text,
  status text,
  reader text,
  page_title text,
  stated_count double precision,
  review_count double precision,
  average double precision,
  stars text,
  left_out text,
  error text,
  attempts double precision,
  checked_at timestamptz,
  card_channel text,
  card_ts text,
  card text,
  decided_by text,
  decided_at timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table if not exists reviews (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  key text,
  source_id double precision,
  product_id text,
  product_handle text,
  review_id text,
  rating double precision,
  review_date text,
  reviewer_name text,
  row text,
  status text,
  batch_id text,
  found_at timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table if not exists review_batches (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  batch_id text,
  status text,
  review_count double precision,
  product_count double precision,
  card_channel text,
  card_ts text,
  card text,
  delivered_at timestamptz,
  imported_by text,
  imported_at timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);
create unique index if not exists review_sites_brand_domain on review_sites (lower(brand), domain);
create index if not exists review_sources_product on review_sources (product_id);
create unique index if not exists reviews_key on reviews (key);
create index if not exists reviews_status on reviews (status, source_id);
create index if not exists reviews_batch on reviews (batch_id);
